title: Last Summer’s Wine
description: Action star Rod Tango takes a dramatic turn, playing a man who discovers a quiet life amongst the grapes.
quote: There’s something magic about this place. It’s in the soil.
altHero: Rod Tango as a waiter sniffing some grapes next to a table with two women

alt2: Rod Tango romancing one of the women
alt3: Rod Tango bringing out a bottle of wine
alt4: Rod Tango gardening, while wearing a purple apron and sun hat
